svg.title: WAIT held only by its pull-up
svg.desc: The card in slot 7 drives WAIT high and releases it at 5 ns; its two neighbours, driven from slot 7, rise at 20 ns and fall at 70 ns. Slow corner, ABT, 10 kilohm pull-up.
svg.text: WAIT at the receiver where it dips most
ns; released at 5, neighbours rise at 20, fall at 70
